crime: Earlier that evening, {WITCH_NAME} threw away their shared supper uneaten. When the girl arrived late at the dining hall, she split the dessert she had saved with {WITCH_NAME}. Over dessert, the girl asked to eat alone that night—just for one evening.

In answer, {WITCH_NAME} unraveled a chipped plate into ceramic thread and knitted it into a crown. She offered the girl a reunion feast the next day, promising it would mark the reconciliation meant for them. Instead, later that evening, the girl set the crown aside on the upper railing.

As the girl leaned over the upper railing, {WITCH_NAME} unraveled the iron supporting her into thread. The girl and the ceramic crown fell to the courtyard path, where the impact killed her. Afterward, {WITCH_NAME} knitted the iron back into a seamless railing. She said the girl had reached too far for the crown and fallen by accident.

But a prisoner found fringe from the girl's sleeve woven through the solid iron of the railing. The trapped fringe revealed what the seamless iron concealed: {WITCH_NAME} had knitted the railing back around the sleeve after taking away the girl's support.
fields.epitaph: She could not endure one evening apart, and made every tomorrow together impossible.
execution: The execution stand locks her upright in a knitting frame. Needles knit iron thread upward around her body, forming the hem of a coronation gown first and closing it at her throat. Its iron collar tightens around her throat and holds there. When the needles stop, she hangs motionless inside the finished gown.

magic.name: Unravel and Remake
magic.text: She can unravel solid, inanimate objects into thread and reknit the same material into new objects.
